JVNDB-2026-000126
PALLET CONTROL products vulnerable to improper access control
Overview
PALLET CONTROL products provided by JAL Information Technology Co., Ltd. include multiple service programs that run in the background and provide certain functions. However, access to these service programs is not properly restricted, allowing non-administrative users to access them.
Improper access control in interprocess communication (CWE-276) - CVE-2026-81302
Hiromichi Kurosu and Masatsugu Ueda of GMO Cybersecurity by Ierae, Inc. reported this vulnerability to IPA.
JPCERT/CC coordinated with the developer under Information Security Early Warning Partnership.

Affected Products
JAL Digital Co.,Ltd.
PALLET CONTROL Ver. 6.3 patch 5 and ealier
PalletControl 10 Update 8 and earlier
PalletControl Cloud  (PalletControl 10 Update 8) and earlier
Impact
An attacker who can log in to a Windows client where the affected product is installed may execute arbitrary code with SYSTEM privileges.
Solution
[Update the Software]
Update the software to the latest version according to the information provided by the developer.
The developer has released the following versions to fix the vulnerability.
PALLET CONTROL Ver. 6.3 patch 6 or later
PalletControl 10 Update 9 or later
PalletControl Cloud (PalletControl 10 Update 9) or later
